verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs show remote state backends: managed Pulumi Cloud, or DIY object stores in AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage and Google Cloud Storage. Nothing in the pack covers state locking or protection against concurrent runs, so only the remote-storage half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented state locking/concurrency protection, details of lock behavior per backend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
